recognize_zh: 這是全血球計數報告：血紅素 11.2 g/dL、MCV 77.6 fL、MCH 24.7 pg、MCHC 31.8 g/dL 皆偏低，而 RDW-CV 與 RDW-SD 顯示為星號（超出儀器可報告範圍），提示紅血球大小差異極大，與鐵劑治療中出現雙相族群（dimorphic）相符。
features: Mild anemia: HGB 11.2 g/dL with RBC 4.53 x10^6/uL
Low red cell indices: MCV 77.6 fL, MCH 24.7 pg, MCHC 31.8 g/dL (microcytic hypochromic)
RDW-CV and RDW-SD not reported (asterisks), indicating values beyond the analyzer's reportable range
Normal WBC 5.92 x10^3/uL with minimally high monocyte percentage (8.3%)
Platelets upper-normal (403 x10^3/uL) with high PCT and P-LCC
describe_en: Complete blood count shows mild microcytic hypochromic anemia (hemoglobin 11.2 g/dL, MCV 77.6 fL, MCH 24.7 pg, MCHC 31.8 g/dL). The RDW-CV and RDW-SD fields are replaced by asterisks, indicating that red cell size heterogeneity exceeds the analyzer's reportable range (manually calculated RDW-SD 80.37 fL per history). The leukocyte count is normal with a borderline increased monocyte percentage, and the platelet count is at the upper limit of normal with increased plateletcrit. In a patient on iron therapy, these indices are consistent with treated iron deficiency producing a dimorphic red cell population; review of the RBC histogram and smear is recommended.

ddx.vs: Thalassemia trait shows microcytosis with a normal or high RBC count and a normal RDW, unlike the markedly elevated RDW here.
ACD is usually normocytic to mildly microcytic with normal RDW and high ferritin.
Sideroblastic anemia can also give a very high RDW with dimorphic cells but shows high ferritin and ring sideroblasts.
